## 0fce75f9162a

**Finding A1 — reproduced override and validator defects.** Generator SHA-256 `1d052a6b65320bdb645cce0fc5576a3f3a86bb442c6872cd3310cca8cf792e40`; canonical rule hash `10e57561942c`.

The advertised exact control `n_blobs=1` is silently ignored in the easy band. With seed 17, sample 0, `difficulty="easy"`, the override grid is byte-for-byte identical to the unoverridden grid, contains two connected foreground components, and passes `self_check`. This contradicts the declared `n_blobs` axis.

The advertised degenerate `texture="blobs_share_cols"` also passes `self_check` with no errors even though it intentionally violates the documented disjoint-column invariant. Applying the canonical rule slides both objects into the same top cells, so the later color overwrites part of the earlier object; the returned grid no longer preserves both shapes. This input belongs to the advertised degenerate override domain, not the lawful training domain, and the validator should reject it rather than certify it.

Evidence: `checks/audit/0fce75f9162a/finding.json`, with the exact input, overrides, validator result, source hashes, supported Racket output, illustrative global-shift rival output, command, and working directory. Supported application receipt: `checks/audit/0fce75f9162a/racket.json`.

No fix was made because this was an audit-only target.
